title: 第5章 六阶灵宠第6章 宠物狐狸
slug: 培养神兽很难我有十只
content_zh:
随着咒语落下，空中浅红色的阵法消散，转而在少年的脚底下浮现出一个白色的阵纹。
检测师暗暗叹了一口气，只是白色的阵纹，说明召唤出来的是一只一阶灵兽。
万灵大陆上的灵兽共分九阶，每个品阶的召唤阵颜色都不相同，从一阶到九阶，分别为白，黄，绿，蓝，紫，橙，红，银，金。
果不其然，从白色召唤阵中踏步而出的灵兽，正是一只一阶单目牛，与楚望山的本命灵兽一样，只是这只单目牛的体型要小上许多，看着像是刚出生不久。
少年倒是没有失望，开心地搂住小牛的脖子，即便只是一阶，他以后也很有可能当上村长呢。
由于大部分人都没有灵主资质，检测的速度很快，马上就要轮到楚清瑶，他们这支队伍已经检测了二十几位，只有三个人检测出了资质，本命灵兽还是都是一阶的。
楚清瑶越发紧张起来，她都跟爹娘夸下海口了，要是没有检测出资质，丢脸可就丢大了。
楚少野看出了她在紧张，抬手拍了拍她的肩，“顺其自然。”
楚清瑶抿了抿唇，“哥，我要是没检测出资质，你可不能笑话我。”
楚少野轻轻一笑，“人生的道路不只有一条，成为不了灵主固然可惜，但还有很多其他的路可以走，不要怕。”
他的声音轻柔，让人觉得十分可靠，楚清瑶顿时觉得没什么好怕的，心情放松不少。
爹娘怎么也不会因为她没有成为灵主，就不要她这个女儿了。
楚清瑶脸上扬起笑意，“哥，你说的对，大部分人都做不成灵主，不也是活的好好的吗？”
楚青鱼默默松开了手中被捏的皱巴巴的衣摆，虽然面上不显，但这段时间她一直都很焦虑。
楚青鱼的父母都不是灵主，她拥有灵主资质的可能性很低，但她很想成为灵主。
成了灵主，她就能和母亲摆脱苦日子，过上更好的生活，至少能每天吃上饱饭。
但听了楚少野的话，楚青鱼却豁然开朗了起来，就算没有成为灵主也没关系，她已经会做绣活了，可以挣钱补贴家用，她们母女两人的生活总会越来越好的。
头一次，楚青鱼抬头看向楚少野的时候没有羞涩，“谢谢你楚大哥，我也不紧张了。”
楚少野笑了笑，楚青鱼因为家庭的原因，性格敏感不说还有些自卑，什么事都闷在心里，能想开是好事。
前面的两个人都没有检测出灵主资质，楚清瑶舒了一口气，尽量淡定的走上前，伸出纤白柔嫩的手轻轻放到通灵兽的背上。

通灵兽发出类似小鸡刚刚破壳的“叽叽”
声，身躯的颜色很快发生改变。
透明的身躯逐渐泛白，与之前检测出资质的那几人的淡白色不同，通灵兽这次的身躯变成了半透明的浓白色。
检测师脸上露出惊讶的神色，“这个透明度，小姑娘，你的天赋很高，本命灵兽应该至少有三阶！”
他迫不及待的拉着楚清瑶走到广场中央，想要验证一下自己的判断。
楚清瑶自己也十分惊讶，被检测师带着走的时候还有些懵，她不仅有灵主资质，天赋还很高吗？
content_en:
As the spell fell, the light red formation in the air dissipated, and a white formation appeared under the young man's feet.
The inspector secretly sighed, but the white formation pattern showed that what was summoned was a first-level spiritual beast.
There are nine levels of spirit beasts in Wanling Continent. The colors of the summoning arrays of each level are different. From level one to level nine, they are white, yellow, green, blue, purple, orange, red, silver, and gold.
As expected, the spirit beast that stepped out of the white summoning array was a first-order single-eyed cow. It was the same as the natal spirit beast in Chu Wangshan, except that the size of this single-eyed cow was much smaller, and it looked like it was just born.
The young man was not disappointed and happily hugged the calf's neck. Even if it was only the first level, he would probably become the village chief in the future.
Since most people do not have the qualifications to be a spirit master, the test is very fast, and it will be Chu Qingyao's turn soon. Their team has already tested more than twenty people, and only three people have tested the qualifications. The natal spirit beasts are still first-level.
Chu Qingyao became more and more nervous. She had already boasted about Haikou to her parents. If her qualifications were not tested, she would be very embarrassed.
Chu Shaoye noticed that she was nervous, raised his hand and patted her shoulder, "Let nature take its course."
Chu Qingyao pursed her lips and said, "Brother, if I don't test for qualifications, you can't laugh at me."
Chu Shaoye smiled softly, "There is more than one path in life. It is a pity not to become a spiritual master, but there are many other paths to take, don't be afraid."
His voice was soft and very reliable. Chu Qingyao suddenly felt that there was nothing to be afraid of and she felt much more relaxed.
There is no way her parents would abandon her as their daughter just because she has not become a spiritual master.
A smile appeared on Chu Qingyao's face, "Brother, you are right. Most people can't become spiritual masters, but aren't they still living well?"
Chu Qingyu silently let go of the crumpled hem of clothes in her hands. Although she didn't show it on her face, she had been feeling anxious during this time.
Chu Qingyu's parents are not spirit masters. The possibility of her possessing the qualifications of a spirit master is very low, but she really wants to become a spirit master.
After becoming a spiritual master, she and her mother would be able to get rid of the hard life and live a better life, at least having enough to eat every day.
But after listening to Chu Shaoye's words, Chu Qingyu suddenly became enlightened. It didn't matter even if she didn't become a spiritual master. She could already do embroidery and could earn money to support the family. The lives of mother and daughter would always get better and better.
For the first time, Chu Qingyu was not shy when he looked up at Chu Shaoye, "Thank you, Brother Chu, I'm not nervous anymore."
Chu Shaoye smiled. Due to family reasons, Chu Qingyu has a sensitive personality and a bit of low self-esteem. He keeps everything in his mind. It's a good thing to think about it.
Neither of the two people in front had detected the qualifications of a spirit master. Chu Qingyao breathed a sigh of relief, stepped forward as calmly as possible, stretched out her delicate white hands and gently placed them on the back of the psychic beast.
The psychic beast makes a "chirp" sound similar to that of a chicken that has just hatched.
With the sound, the color of the body quickly changed.
The transparent body gradually turned white. Different from the pale white of the people whose qualifications were detected before, the body of the psychic beast this time turned into a translucent thick white.
There was a look of surprise on the examiner's face, "This transparency, little girl, you are very talented. Your natal spirit beast should be at least the third level!"
He couldn't wait to pull Chu Qingyao to the center of the square, wanting to test his judgment.
Chu Qingyao herself was also very surprised. She was still a little confused when she was taken away by the inspector. Not only did she have the qualifications of a spirit master, but was she also very talented?
